metadata.label: Usage: Terms
metadata.description: Terms are supplemental documents intended to clarify licenses, and inform users how to best comply with license requirements. Collections may create their own Terms documents, but an Arctos-wide approach is strongly encouraged where possible. Terms should not be confused or confounded with data licenses, loan policies, or loan agreements. Must have a URL to a more or less stable document (no google docs please!). Online hosting is available.
